method: startup A/B: the shell is restarted with the enabled set minus every measured plugin (baseline) and with that set plus one plugin; after listPlugins reports every installed plugin and a settle, a window opens in which utime+stime is read from /proc/<pid>/stat at both ends, Pss from /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup and VmRSS from /proc/<pid>/status are traced twice a second and taken at the end of the window (the same two also recorded at the settle, where they were measured to be 8 times noisier), descendants are sampled twice a second and the CPU of reaped children comes from cutime+cstime of the shell pid; each plugin row is the median over runs of (plus minus baseline, run by run) with the spread (max minus min); a delta whose absolute median is not above the baseline spread is within noise

noiseFloor.origin: the spread (max minus min) of the 5 baseline run(s): Pss and VmRSS at the end of the window (the headline), the same two at the settle, and CPU percent over the window
